item.title: Version 1.0.11
item.description:
What's new

  • Pengo can now swim: he paddles through the window with his flippers and feet, turns to face where he is going and looks up or down along the way.
  • Pengo can look up and down by moving just his head.
  • Your pet reminds you before meetings (on by default, 5 minutes before). Reminders for other calendar events can be turned on in Settings.
